tools.name: lebenslauf_erstellen
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their German CV (Lebenslauf) laid out as a real, finished document. Pass only facts the user actually gave you. Returns an interactive preview card where the user can switch template and colour, download a watermarked PDF, or continue in the LebenslaufHeld editor. Run vo

tools.name: anschreiben_erstellen
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a German cover letter (Anschreiben) laid out as a finished German business letter. You write the paragraphs together with the user, based only on their real experience and the job ad; never invent numbers, names or achievements, and do not leave placeholders like [Firma]

tools.name: design_aendern
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a different template (Vorlage) or accent colour for a CV or cover letter created in this chat. Needs entwurf_id. The content stays unchanged. Also called by the preview card itself.

tools.name: ats_check
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know whether their existing CV PDF can be read by applicant tracking systems (ATS). Purely technical and deterministic, no AI: text layer, fonts, date formats, standard headings. Pass the uploaded PDF as datei (or as pdf_base64). It does not judge the content.

tools.name: vollstaendigkeits_check
tools.description: Use this before lebenslauf_erstellen to check German CV data for missing contact details, gaps and empty sections. Rule based, no AI. The hints are editorial recommendations, not legal requirements, and never block the export.

tools.name: vorlagen_liste
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which CV designs are available. Lists all LebenslaufHeld templates with preview image URLs.

tools.name: beruf_beispiel
tools.description: Use this when you need a reference for a specific profession: what a convincing German CV in that job contains, with example phrasing and skill lists from the LebenslaufHeld profession pages. Use it as inspiration only, never copy facts into the user's CV.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lebenslauf_erstellen" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Create a German CV as a real PDF in a professional design. Erstellt aus strukturierten Lebenslauf-Daten eine Vorschau, einen Link zum Wasserzeichen-PDF (gratis) und einen Link, um den Entwurf im LebenslaufHeld-Editor weiterzubearbeiten." → after: "Use this when the user wants their German CV (Lebenslauf) laid out as a real, finished document. Pass only facts the user actually gave you. Returns an interactive preview card where the user can switch template and colour, download a watermarked PDF, or continue in the LebenslaufHeld editor. Run vo"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
